question: Who Owns Del Taco?
quick_answer: Del Taco is owned by Yadav Enterprises Inc., one of the largest franchise operators in the US. In October 2025, Jack in the Box agreed to sell Del Taco Holdings to Yadav for about $115 million, ending Jack in the Box's roughly three-year ownership. Del Taco was founded in 1964 in Yermo, California.
key_facts: Founders: Ed Hackbarth and David Jameson
Deal: Jack in the Box agreed to sell Del Taco for ~$115 million (announced Oct 2025)
Previous owner: Jack in the Box (from 2022)

body.heading: Who owns Del Taco now?
body.text: Del Taco is owned by Yadav Enterprises Inc., a large, privately held franchise operator. In October 2025, Jack in the Box announced a definitive agreement to sell Del Taco Holdings to Yadav Enterprises for approximately $115 million, and the sale moved Del Taco out of Jack in the Box's hands. Yadav is one of the biggest franchisees in the country, operating hundreds of restaurants across several brands.

body.heading: Del Taco's ownership history
body.text: Del Taco was founded in 1964 by Ed Hackbarth and David Jameson in Yermo, California. For decades it grew as a regional Mexican-American fast-food chain. In 2015 it went public on the Nasdaq (ticker TACO) through a merger with Levy Acquisition Corp. Jack in the Box then acquired Del Taco in March 2022 for about $575 million, before agreeing to sell it to Yadav Enterprises in 2025.

body.heading: Why did Jack in the Box sell Del Taco?
body.text: Jack in the Box moved to sell Del Taco as it refocused on its core Jack in the Box brand and worked to simplify the company. Selling Del Taco to a large, experienced franchise operator like Yadav Enterprises let Jack in the Box raise cash and let Del Taco sit with an owner focused on running and growing it.

faqs.q: Is Del Taco owned by Jack in the Box?
faqs.a: Not anymore. Jack in the Box owned Del Taco from 2022, but in October 2025 it agreed to sell Del Taco to Yadav Enterprises Inc. for about $115 million.
Del Taco was founded in 1964 in Yermo, California, by Ed Hackbarth and David Jameson.

faqs.q: Is Del Taco a public company?
faqs.a: No. Del Taco was publicly traded from 2015 to 2022, but after Jack in the Box bought it and then sold it to Yadav Enterprises, it is privately held.
